conventions.moments: Sagging positive, kN m/m. For Hahn, M = p*lx*ly/k. Corner twisting comparisons use magnitudes.
conventions.deflection: Positive down, m. Hahn free-edge midspan w = p*lx*ly*lx^2/(omega*E*h^3).
conventions.reactions: Global Z up, kN. PyNite open-edge sums exclude corner nodes. Ritz H17 integrates effective shear.
conventions.corners: PyNite nodal corner reactions and Ritz signed twisting jumps are stored separately.
